scope: Bounded primary-source evidence: two exact Bungie patch articles and one pinned inventory definition. No exhaustive intervening-patch audit or live-game validation.
textNormalization: Python HTMLParser(convert_charrefs=True): collect handle_data chunks, join with spaces, then collapse Unicode whitespace. Match case-sensitive substrings after the named heading, within 300 normalized characters.

retrieval.pageResult: Canonical article URLs returned HTTP 200 JavaScript shells; their hashes are not article-body evidence.
retrieval.recipe: GET Bungie /Platform/Settings/. Read Response.systems.ContentStack.parameters.ApiKey and parse EnvPlusDeliveryToken as {environment}{deliveryToken}; use api_key and access_token request headers in memory. GET the two recorded CMS requestUrl values (exact url.hosted_url, locale=en-us, environment=live, limit=2, include_count=true); require one matching entry each. Preserve raw response bytes before parsing. Do not execute response text. Do not publish delivery headers/tokens.
